name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task's only sentence is a condition — 'If you reach the exit' makes at_exit the 'if' event, not a commanded goal, so no Existence(at_exit) is wanted, and switch_toggled is owed only when the exit is reached, so it is not a goal either. The single hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) states exactly this restriction (at_exit may not happen before the first switch_toggled), matching the wording 'must have flipped the switch first' with 'must' making it hard. The empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are valid for a task whose only requirement is such a conditional rule, and the machine's u2 well with the -10 break reward reflects the hard rule correctly.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been toggled first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
